comparison.objective: Break open an ampoule while retaining its cap in an opener; candidate releases and removes a connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Protective enclosure, controlled fracture, and cap capture versus dual-blade insertion around a contact and sustained tang depression during wire pull.
comparison.success_condition: Requires confirmed neck break, contained cap, upright body, and returned opener; candidate requires selective rearward terminal exit with no prohibited damage. Candidate damage thresholds are not numeric.
comparison.reason: Both use a specialized tool, but controlled fracture and fragment containment do not test latch-tang release.
